correctness.rationale: For \(d\ge2\) and all strictly positive parameters, the facet normal enumeration and determinant sum give the exact surface and volume formulas. The dimensionless diagonal-parameter derivative has unique strict zero \(p=d(d-1)/B-1>0\). Normalized Newton log-concavity \(E_d\le E_2^{d-1}\), combined with \(E_2\le1\), proves the global minimum and exact equality class. Thirty-five independent SciPy ConvexHull comparisons in dimensions two through six verify facet normalization; finite computation is supportive only.
